groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: after the Venus Junction, from the Codex; gives the Incubator Segment

conditions: During the quest's egg step dens drop eggs 100% of the time; that first hatch is still a random breed.
Maturing your first Kubrow unlocks the collar permanently for every later one.
The blueprint is a reusable 50,000-credit Market purchase; every incubation consumes a core, and the 100,000-credit build adds up over rerolls.

rows.label: Chesa Kubrow
rows.note: random result among Huras, Raksa, Sahasa, Sunika, Chesa
rows.alt: use two Chesa Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Roughly 1 in 5 per roll with no pity; a wrong breed means another egg, core and 48-hour wait.
Two Chesa imprints make Chesa the likely result, not a guaranteed one, and still consume an egg and core.
Don't pick the Helminth cyst Drain option; it guarantees a Helminth Charger, never a Chesa.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment. Mature it manually in the Incubator before missions.
bonuses: Chesa imprints are tradeable: a friend's Chesa gives up to two, 1.5 hours each. Empty templates come from a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 10,000 credits and 6 hours a build.
Its Chesa Claws level but give no Mastery; fur, size and eye color don't change stats.

disclosures.title: switch to imprints after a miss or two
disclosures.body: One player rolled seven Huras in a row before switching to imprints; another took weeks to land a breed. The least painful order is Howl of the Kubrow first, a batch of eggs in one sitting, cores built in parallel, and a friend's Chesa imprints if the first couple of random rolls miss.
